note: Keys the controls screen lists but does not let you rebind (game/scripts/controls_ui.gd): they are handled directly in a script, not through rg::Controls' action schema. This file DESCRIBES what the code does and must be kept in step with it by hand. Everything else in the game is a rebindable action (data/controls/actions.json).

entries.label: Pause menu (Esc also closes a panel or releases the mouse first; the menu 'Back' action is rebindable)
With the 'Truck ahead' key: removes the truck instead of adding one
